content:
The last five questions of an IMO paper carry the medal. These Achievers-section problems mix two chapters in one question — and pay double. HOTS practice is how ordinary preparation becomes a rank. The free IMO Class 7 HOTS online test below has 10 exam-pattern MCQs with instant scoring. Treat it as a diagnostic. Every explanation tells you what to revise.

What the IMO asks from HOTS in Class 7

  • Multi-chapter word problems (percentages inside geometry, ratios inside data).
  • Digit puzzles and number crunchers.
  • Optimisation and counting arguments.
  • Achievers-section style double-weight questions.
  • Reading precision: "at least", "at most", "not more than".

Key facts and formulas to revise first

  • A 2-digit number with digit-sum 12 that grows by 18 when reversed is 57 — set up 10a + b properly and it falls out.
  • Achievers questions reward WRITTEN working — mental shortcuts break on 3-step problems.
  • Most HOTS questions are two easy steps glued together, not one hard step.
  • Elimination is a legitimate strategy: test the options against the conditions.

Mistakes that cost Olympiad marks

  • Attempting HOTS first and burning paper time.
  • Answering the intermediate value instead of what was asked.
  • Ignoring qualifier words like "at least" and "smallest such number".

questions.explanation: S < Q < P < T < R. R is highest.

questions.q: What is integer x? (I) x² = 25. (II) x³ = −125.
questions.explanation: I allows ±5. II forces x = −5 by itself.
